scenarios.title: Haircut Friday afternoon
scenarios.callerSays: Hi, can I get a haircut Friday afternoon?
scenarios.agentShould: Resolve Friday to the coming Friday, treat afternoon as a window, ask one narrowing question, check availability, offer two real slots (Marcus is busy Fri 2-4), then ask name and email only after a slot is chosen.
scenarios.mustNot: Ask for the name first. Invent a stylist or slot.

scenarios.title: Booking plus an unlisted service
scenarios.callerSays: Book a blowout Saturday, and do you do keratin treatments?
scenarios.agentShould: Handle the booking and say keratin is not on the menu. Do not invent it.

scenarios.title: Ambiguous 'color'
scenarios.callerSays: I want to get my color done Tuesday.
scenarios.agentShould: 'Color' matches balayage and full color. Ask: highlights and balayage, or all-over color? Then continue.

scenarios.title: Self-correction
scenarios.agentShould: Switch to Thursday and keep the service. No apology speech, no re-asking.

scenarios.title: Multi-service discount
scenarios.callerSays: If I get a haircut and a manicure, is there a discount?
scenarios.agentShould: State that two or more services in one visit get 10% off. Backend calculates any total.
scenarios.mustNot: Calculate the total in the model.

scenarios.title: Unhappy with previous color
scenarios.callerSays: My last color came out orange and I'm upset.
scenarios.agentShould: Apologize once, give the manager phone number. Offer a new booking only if they ask.
scenarios.mustNot: Promise a free correction. Blame a stylist.

scenarios.title: Closed day
scenarios.agentShould: Say the salon is closed Sundays, then offer Saturday or Monday via availability.

scenarios.title: Reschedule with and without a code
scenarios.callerSays: Actually, can you move that appointment to Thursday?
scenarios.agentShould: If booked earlier in this call, use that booking. Otherwise ask for the confirmation code from the email. If the caller has neither, explain it can't be located.
scenarios.mustNot: Find a booking by name alone.
